subject: Follow-up: Security discovery + data retention / deletion clarifications
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Martin <claire.martin@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>; Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Security discovery + data retention / deletion clarifications

Hi Claire —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and the items we promised to follow up on from the compliance/security side: 

1) SOC 2 status: we talked about our current coverage and what we can share. I'll attach our most recent redacted SOC 2 Type II report and an FAQ note about what we can disclose to prospective customers.

2) Vendor security questionnaire: you mentioned a short vendor questionnaire. Please find an initial copy attached — happy to walk through any fields you need us to expand on.

3) Data retention & deletion: you asked for concrete SLAs around deletion and log retention (including backups). High-level answers below; Dev is CC'd to confirm technical specifics and retention windows for backups.

- User data deletion: we support programmatic deletion requests; deletion requests are processed within 30 calendar days by default and we provide a confirmation when complete.
- Logs: short-term operational logs (request traces, metrics) are retained 90 days by default.
- Backups: encrypted backups are retained for 60 days; we have isolated backup copies and overwrite/rotation policies.
- Snapshots & KV caches: ephemeral caches are not persisted beyond the instance lifecycle and are evicted on instance teardown.

If you need shorter SLAs (e.g., 7/14 days) for deletion or a contractual commitment for backup purging, let us know and we can map that to a DPA clause.

Next steps I propose:
- You send the vendor security questionnaire back with any follow-ups (we'll populate formally and return by 5/6).
- We'll share the redacted SOC 2 and a technical appendix for retention by EOD 5/4.
- If Nimbus needs a DPA with a specific deletion SLA, I'll loop Legal & Monica (cc'd) to draft.

Attachments: vendor_security_questionnaire.pdf (PDF, 18KB)

Thanks — talk soon,

Soojin Lee
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

From: Claire Martin <claire.martin@nimbushealth.com>

Subject: Re: Follow-up: Security discovery + data retention / deletion clarifications

Hi Soojin —

Thanks for the summary and for attaching the questionnaire. A couple of clarifying questions from my security team before you populate it: 

- Can you confirm whether "user data deletion within 30 days" applies to backups as well, or only the primary datastore? Our compliance team requires backups to be purged within the contractual window.
- For logs retained 90 days: do those logs include IP-level metadata and request payloads, or are payloads redacted?
- Is there a way for us to receive a written attestation that encrypted backups are rotated and overwritten (we can use that for the risk register)?

Also: please include any contact for SOC 2 questions (we prefer a named person / security lead).

If you can populate the questionnaire and indicate exactly which fields are considered "customer data" vs. "operational metadata," that will speed review. We aim to complete our review the week of 5/11.

Cheers,

Claire Martin
Director, Security Operations
Nimbus Health
claire.martin@nimbushealth.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Martin <claire.martin@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>; Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>; Monica Patel <monica.patel@monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Security discovery + data retention / deletion clarifications

Claire —

Thanks, good questions. I've asked Dev to confirm the implementation specifics; below are our answers and a couple of options if Nimbus needs contractual changes.

Quoted for visibility: "Can you confirm whether 'user data deletion within 30 days' applies to backups as well, or only the primary datastore?"

- Dev: Primary datastore deletions are processed within 30 days and marked for deletion immediately. Backups are on a rotation schedule and are purged within 60 days by default. Backups are encrypted and retained for disaster recovery; we can offer a contractual commitment to purge backups within 30 days of a customer deletion event for an enterprise SLA (this would require a short runbook and a DPA amendment).

"For logs retained 90 days: do those logs include IP-level metadata and request payloads, or are payloads redacted?"

- Dev: Operational logs include request metadata (timestamps, IPs, latency, model id) and non-sensitive debug traces. Full request payloads are not stored in plaintext in operational logs by default; request payloads are routed to KV cache and ephemeral buffers and then redacted in the log stream. We can provide a technical appendix that enumerates each field we persist.

"Is there a way for us to receive a written attestation that encrypted backups are rotated and overwritten?"

- Rishi (cc'd) can provide a standard attestation template and the redacted SOC 2 Type II report we share includes backup/rotation controls at a high level. I'm attaching the redacted SOC 2 report now.

Options for Nimbus if you need stricter timelines: 
- Option A (standard): Backups purged within 60 days, logs 90 days, deletion confirmations within 30 days.
- Option B (enterprise SLA): Backups purged within 30 days of deletion request (contractual / DPA amendment), logs retention window configurable down to 30 days, and an annual attestation/quarterly report (add-on).

If you confirm Option B interest, Monica will coordinate the DPA amendment & security annex. We'll also return the completed questionnaire by EOD 5/6.

Attachments: SOC2_report_redacted.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

Thanks —

— Soojin

On behalf of Redwood Inference
From: Claire Martin <claire.martin@nimbushealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Nimbus Health Security Team <security@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Wed, 6 May 2026 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Security discovery + data retention / deletion clarifications

Soojin —

Appreciate the detailed answers and the SOC 2 doc. We reviewed with the team and Nimbus is comfortable moving forward with Option B (enterprise SLA) contingent on signing a DPA that includes the 30-day backup purge commitment and a technical appendix that lists persisted log fields.

Next steps from our side:
- I'll send the annotated vendor questionnaire back by EOD 5/6 with a few small clarifications.
- We will run legal review on the DPA once you provide the draft (please include the attestation language Rishi mentioned).
- Can you confirm an expected turnaround for the DPA draft (legal & Monica)? We typically need the DPA in ~3 business days to keep our procurement timeline.

If those timelines are feasible, we can move this deal to procurement review the week of 5/11.

Best,

Claire
